WEAKSEIMHIUGEN: Usually lenited here, but not if the second noun is a person, an animal or other living thing, or a part of one, or if the first noun is part of the second
WEAKBACHOIRIN: Usually i with eclipsis here (i mBostún), but in is correct before a foreign place name that has not been Gaelicised (in Mumbai)
NAIMPER: The negative of the imperative is /ná/ (with h before a vowel: ná habair)
CORASSEIMHIU: This dative follows /Córas an tSéimhithe/ (/ar an bhosca/, /ar an tsuíochán/, /ar an eitleán dhubh/), but elsewhere the text follows /an Córas Lárnach/: keep to one system (CO17 1.7.1)
CORASLARNACH: This dative follows /an Córas Lárnach/ (/ar an mbosca/, /ar an suíochán/, /ar an eitleán dubh/), but elsewhere the text follows /Córas an tSéimhithe/: keep to one system (CO17 1.7.1)
WEAKBACHOIRAR: Usually /ar/ here, after áit, fáth, caoi and similar nouns (CO17 11.3.1(h)), but not when the noun is the object of the verb
